item.title: Trump’s ‘America First’ campaign battle cry gives way to military strikes abroad
item.description: Trump’s decision to strike Iran pulls him toward the kind of conflict he once attacked.

item.title: Heat power past Powell absence with 115-105 statement victory over Rockets
item.description: This time the Miami Heat got closing time right. After blown fourth-quarter leads in their previous two games, the Heat this time held their ground in a victory over the Houston Rockets.

item.title: Winderman’s view: Heat’s Adebayo, Ware double up in win as productive, positive pairing
item.description: Ira Winderman's perspectives and other items of note from the Miami Heat's Saturday game against the Houston Rockets.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for March 01, 2026
item.description: The process of healing can genuinely make us stronger. While the Moon trines vigilant Chiron at 9:08 pm EST, we'll probably find it easier to share and repair feelings with care. Everyone's hearts are closer to the surface than usual, so being tolerant of one another's idiosyncrasies could be necessary to avoid strife. item.title: Daughtry, Calvary Christian soar by St. Andrew’s to reach 3A final four
item.description: Caden Daughtry scored 13 of his team-high 21 points in the second quarter to break open a close game.

item.title: No. 23 Gators score winning run on balk to take series from No. 22 Hurricanes
item.description: The Gators took a late lead over the Hurricanes on a seventh-inning balk before securing an 8-4, series-clinching win over Miami.

item.title: Rally falls short as UCF sees three-game win streak snapped by Baylor
item.description: The Knights rallied from a double-digit deficit in the final six minutes to tie the game before a late foul cost them the game.

item.title: No. 7 Gators enter March red hot after rout of No. 20 Arkansas
item.description: No. 7 Florida picked up its ninth straight win with a 111-77 rout of No. 20 Arkansas to secure the Gators' eighth SEC regular-season title.

item.title: St. Thomas Aquinas wins record 16th state girls soccer title; American Heritage grabs fourth straight
item.description: Cypress Bay, who got three first-half goals by Mackenzie Rector in their state semi win, were turned back again in the title game by St. Mary's.
